name: view_guard_and_derived_down
comment: ADR-0017 add.1 and ADR-0018 on PostgreSQL (ADR-0043): pg_get_viewdef reformats a view, so the MIG-012 guard round-trips the expected body through a probe view and compares the engine's two renderings. A hotfixed definition still refuses, force recreates, and the derived rollback (guard, drop, previous definition rendered by the dialect) works the same. No `ddl` deep expect: the stored text is not verbatim here.
